text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, come get into a nasty quarrel
with me!
Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
See, I heard a rumor from a classmate. If
two
people confess their feelings for
each other under
the last tree lining the
main walkway, they'll be
inseparable for
life.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But if their feelings don't align and it
leads to a
quarrel, they'll resent each
other for life instead...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So we must go and get into a quarrel! No
jinx can
stop us. We'll prove that we can
still be just as
close afterwards!
